g.text: A closer view of the predicted NE–Elafin interface
Human neutrophil elastase · Elafin reactive loop | HDOCK original rank 29 · post-hoc geometric candidate
NE · chain E (teal) Elafin · chain I (coral) C gray · O red · N blue · S yellow
Dashed segments report heavy-atom separations, not assigned hydrogen bonds. The 2.18 Å O···O contact is unusually short.
Unrelaxed rigid-body prediction; mature Elafin / NE author numbering. No experimentally validated interface or affinity is implied.
